mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 7.5% over two consecutive months signals tightening labor market conditions, increasing wage pressures and corporate profit margins, which drives positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in instances where UNRATE < 7.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which boosts corporate revenues and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side activity, which may signal an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as risk-off sentiment intensifies.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 95.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a synchronized surge in consumer and housing demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during co-movements of RSAFS and HOUST (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market recovery, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) on a quarterly basis, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong aggregate demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).
